title: Implement Wasm Tiled Vello Board
description: Implement .repo/✍️/new-wasm-tile-vello-react-reconsile-board.md by wiring the existing elements/client/lib/board stack end-to-end. Use the existing files only: elements/client/lib/board/rs/lib.rs, elements/client/lib/board/js/index.ts, and elements/client/lib/board/react/index.tsx, plus any existing package/project config files that are required for the build/test path. Build a Rust-owned retained board engine with a thin imperative JS facade and a React custom-reconciled or React-driven declarative surface that mutates the imperative objects. Keep the implementation minimal but real: stable ids, nodes/handles/edges, edge geometry recompute, camera, pointer interaction plumbing, dirty/invalidation behavior, and a renderable canvas output path. Validate end-to-end with the relevant builds/tests and runtime-level checks that are feasible in this workspace. Do not create new feature files when the existing board files can be extended.
